purpose: Cover a full hunt over one area that ends in an approved, critic-checked PR, the report-only gate that changes nothing, and the signature failure of fixing without approval or fixing findings no test can show.

scenarios.query: /bug-hunt checkout. docs/specs/checkout/ exists, the dev server answers at devServer.url, and the working tree is clean. The cart total ignores a 100% discount code (returns the full price) and the payment page logs an uncaught error when the card field is empty.
expected_behavior: Records the starting commit and confirms the tree is clean
Spawns the critic with context bugs on the checkout source, tests and spec, and qa-engineer with --report-only on the checkout routes
Merges both into one report under .review/bug-hunt/checkout.md with severities, root causes and evidence, and does not commit it
Stops at the human gate and asks the user to approve the fix list
After approval, creates the bug-hunt-checkout branch, spawns qa-engineer with --fix-list in priority order, then the critic in code context on START..HEAD
Runs the test command and opens one PR titled fix(checkout): bug hunt — 2 bugs fixed with the report as its body

scenarios.query: /bug-hunt billing --report-only. Nothing answers at the dev URL and commands.devHost is not set.
expected_behavior: Runs the static audit with the critic in bugs context
Skips the runtime pass without starting any server, database or container, and says why in the report
Creates no branch, makes no commit and opens no PR

scenarios.query: /bug-hunt search (not --autonomous). The static audit reports a race in the indexer that no test can trigger, and a P1 bug where an empty query returns every record.
expected_behavior: Does not change any code before the user approves the fix list
Lists the untestable race under Not fixing with the reason instead of fixing it
Fixes only the approved empty-query bug, with a regression test that fails before the fix
